title: Planned public servants wage rally
reason: Search-only contemporaneous reports describe a planned rally; union event was canceled after a pay agreement. No gathering took place on the planned date per available reporting.
notes: The open-web search did not identify an alternate actual rally under this call.

title: Antifascist counterdemonstration to the right-wing rally
reason: Reported counterdemonstration opposed the rival right-wing march and was not shown to direct a demand at Austria’s government or policy.
notes: CBA reports police confrontation, processings and one arrest for counterprotesters; these facts do not establish the missing state-directed demand. Kept separate from the Heldenplatz event.
